title: Keys become prompts and updates become redraws
body:
The pieces need a loop.

## Proposal

`src/main.rs` and `src/acp.rs`: the program takes the agent command on its
command line, spawns it, runs the ACP client connection on a tokio LocalSet,
and runs one loop over two sources: crossterm key events, and session updates
from the connection. Enter sends the input as a prompt; Esc cancels a prompt
in flight; Ctrl+c quits. Every update goes through `Transcript::apply` and
redraws. Permission requests are answered with the first allow option until
the screen has a way to ask.

## Open

- Whether the agent command is an argument or a config file. An argument
  first.
